visualCharacteristics: A small trail of links back to parent pages, separated by > and ending with the current page as plain text. The slash variant shows an inline trail with orange / separators.
contentPattern: One row, one cell holding a list: each item is a link to an ancestor page, and the last item is the current page title as plain text.
usage: Use it to show the page location trail on content pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it on every page that needs a breadcrumb trail; there is no other block for this.
